sources.title: Climate Of Maldives
sources.evidence: January–March is the northeast dry monsoon; April and December are transitions. The southwest wet monsoon normally lasts mid-May–November. Warm and humid year-round; March–mid-May is warmest. Showers can have sunny intervals; southern atolls are wetter. These are climatic patterns, not trip forecasts.

sources.title: The Best Time of Year to Visit Cape Town
sources.evidence: January–February usually brings hot, mostly dry weather, long daylight and possible wind; January is peak season and February remains busy. March begins shoulder season but major event weekends attract crowds. November–December brings long, warm days and the start of peak season, with increasing wind. Event schedules and listed commercial prices are not used.

sources.title: Best Seasons to Visit Mexico City
sources.publisher: Mexico City tourism portal, Government of Mexico City
sources.evidence: Summer is rainier; March–May and September–November avoid the extremes of cold and rain, with warm afternoons and cooler evenings. December–February nights and early mornings sometimes approach freezing. Direct sunlight can be intense year-round. The page contains dated event details; only general seasonal guidance is used.

sources.title: Weather in Sydney
sources.evidence: December–February is warm summer, with higher humidity and warmer beach water. December has the longest daylight. Its summer climate table lists rain in all three months, increasing from December to February; the guidance also recommends sun protection. This supports seasonal beach appeal, not dry-weather or uncrowded-season guarantees.

sources.title: Bangkok — historical 1961–1990 climate normals
sources.publisher: World Meteorological Organization / Thai Meteorological Department
sources.evidence: The retrieved 1961–1990 climate table shows December and January with much less rain than May–October; February is also comparatively dry. Mean daily highs are about 31–33°C across December–February, and February nights are warmer than January. This old baseline supports broad seasonality only; no current temperatures or forecasts are asserted.

sources.title: Clima
sources.evidence: Summer runs from late December into March. Summer heat is humid, increases strongly around midday and early afternoon, and eases only slightly at night, allowing light clothing. Spring extends into December and is among the rainier seasons. This supports warm-evening appeal but contradicts treating January–February as reliably mild sightseeing weather.

sources.title: Seasonal Information
sources.evidence: Spring and autumn are described as comfortable and popular. Warming begins during March; successive spring flowers include April cherry blossoms. Autumn stays warm through October, then cools in November as maple colors deepen. Seasonal calendars describe variable blooming/leaf periods, not guaranteed dates. June–July is the main rainy season.

sources.title: Weather & Clothing
sources.evidence: March visitors are advised to bring a thick coat and sweater; April–May calls for a portable jacket or long sleeves. Autumn days can be warm but mornings and nights are chilly, with sudden temperature drops; layers are recommended. Supports cold-edge caveats without claiming rain-free spring or autumn.

sources.title: Japan in May
sources.evidence: May is generally neither too hot nor too cold. Golden Week spans late April and early May, one of Japan's busiest travel periods, with packed trains and hotels; the second half of May is calmer, before June's rainy season. Nationwide holiday guidance applies to Kyoto and Tokyo; it is not a city-specific crowd forecast.

sources.title: Marrakech — 1991–2020 climate normals
sources.publisher: World Meteorological Organization / Direction de la Météorologie Nationale, Morocco
sources.evidence: Retrieved 1991–2020 averages: March/April daily highs about 24/26°C, cool nights and measurable rain; May about 29°C, drier but warmer. October about 29°C by day versus July/August near 38°C. November about 23°C by day and 11°C at night, with more rain than October. Monthly means are not forecasts or limits on extremes.

sources.title: Weather, Geography
sources.publisher: Tokyo Convention & Visitors Bureau, GO TOKYO
sources.evidence: Early spring remains chilly; May brings new greenery and comfortably warm days, with cooler mornings/evenings. Autumn temperature and humidity gradually fall; typhoons can disrupt travel and outdoor events. Leaf color begins in western mountain areas before spreading elsewhere. November calls for layers. Island climate sections are not generalized to central Tokyo.

sources.title: Best Things to Do and See in Tokyo in April
sources.publisher: Tokyo Convention & Visitors Bureau, GO TOKYO
sources.evidence: April offers spring flowers and warm, mild walking weather; cherry-blossom events are hugely popular and hanami draws crowds. Rain and windy days occur. The numerical weather guidance explicitly uses 2025 data, not long-term normals, so those numbers are not used in notes; no exact bloom dates are promised.

sources.title: Best Things to Do and See in Tokyo in November
sources.publisher: Tokyo Convention & Visitors Bureau, GO TOKYO
sources.evidence: November is highlighted for autumn foliage and ginkgo avenues. Sunny days can feel warm, while windy days and evenings are chilly; mountain areas are colder than central Tokyo. The page's numerical weather guidance uses 2025 observations, not long-term normals, so no numerical rainfall or temperature claim is carried into notes.

sources.title: Weather, Climate & Seasons
sources.publisher: Indonesia Travel — Ministry of Tourism, Indonesia
sources.evidence: Includes Bali in the generally April–October dry season; describes regional variation, high humidity and less predictable season boundaries. This is broad climate guidance, not a forecast or a promise of rain-free days.

sources.title: Bali Weather by Month: When to Actually Go
sources.evidence: April is a transition with decreasing rain but lingering showers and humidity; June is generally drier. July–August are dry but busy with higher demand; September generally stays dry with rain gradually increasing. Conditions vary by location and year.

sources.title: The best hiking trails in Italy
sources.evidence: The Path of the Gods section recommends spring or autumn because it is less hot. It also warns that the route is unsuitable for people with vertigo; seasonal appeal does not establish universal hiking suitability.

sources.title: Best time to visit the Amalfi Coast
sources.evidence: May suits walking but bus queues occur; June has settled summer weather and is already busy. September has warm sea but popular places and cruise arrivals remain busy. October can bring thunderstorms and seasonal closures; bad weather can suspend ferries. Commercial travel guidance, not service guarantees.

sources.title: Weather in Positano: rain, temperatures, and sea forecast
sources.evidence: May is milder than June in its monthly table; rain occurs in all assigned months. Summer daytime heat regularly exceeds 30°C. The sea is generally more comfortable from June; September remains warm. Local topography can cause sudden thunderstorms. Table methodology is not stated; no exact figures are used in notes.

sources.title: Traveller information
sources.evidence: Lisbon has hot summers moderated by proximity to the sea; spring and autumn usually have sunny days and mild temperatures. This is seasonal guidance; its temperature table groups three months together, so it is not used as exact monthly data.

sources.title: Normal Climatológica – Lisboa / Instituto Geofísico 1991-2020
sources.publisher: Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera (IPMA)
sources.evidence: For May/June/September/October, mean daily maxima are 23.1/26.1/26.6/22.8°C and monthly precipitation 57.8/14.1/38.6/110.6mm. June and September both average days above 30°C; nights are cooler. Station normals combine observed and modeled data; they are not trip forecasts.

sources.title: Greek Travel Blossoms
sources.publisher: Greek National Tourism Organisation — Visit Greece
sources.evidence: March–May is spring; the article gives Santorini a May average daily high around 24°C and recommends warmer clothes for cold days and late nights. It describes spring as less crowded than summer, not crowd-free.

sources.title: Santorini: Sunset overlooking the caldera
sources.publisher: Greek National Tourism Organisation — Visit Greece
sources.evidence: The caldera route is recommended from spring to autumn. In summer, hikes should start very early or be avoided when heat or humidity makes conditions unsuitable. This supports seasonal walking appeal, not guaranteed safe conditions.

sources.title: The best time to visit Santorini: a seasonal guide
sources.evidence: May–June and September–October are shoulder seasons with generally warm weather and fewer crowds than July–August. June has open-air attractions; September has sea warmed through summer. Early May and late October can have cool breezes; some businesses close in late October.

sources.title: Visiting Iceland in the Summer
sources.evidence: June–August has long daylight and seasonal hiking access; July is traditionally warmest. Summer is busiest and still cool, windy and changeable; late-August rain can increase. Highland F-road openings depend on conditions and may be late June or early July. No all-roads-open claim is adopted.

sources.title: South Iceland
sources.evidence: June brings near-continuous daylight; Highland access is seasonal and opening dates depend on conditions. September–October brings shorter, cooler days and possible northern lights with clear skies. Seasonal roads and some operators scale back toward winter. Source scope is South Iceland, not every mountain road nationwide.

sources.title: Summer in Amsterdam
sources.evidence: Official summer page highlights parks, urban beaches, terraces, outdoor cinema, art and festivals. Its outdoor recommendations are framed around sunny days; it does not guarantee weather or any particular event schedule.

sources.title: The weather in the Netherlands
sources.publisher: Netherlands Board of Tourism & Conventions — Holland.com
sources.evidence: Dutch summers are generally temperate, with daytime averages in the low to mid-20s°C, but rainy spells and heatwaves can occur. Rain falls in every season. September is cooler than summer. This is national guidance; provinces differ and no exact Amsterdam forecast is implied.

sources.title: Autumn in Amsterdam
sources.evidence: Autumn brings shorter evenings and the cultural season in full swing. The page discusses autumn generally; it does not establish a date for leaf colour, so September notes make no foliage promise.

sources.title: Time zone, time to visit, and weather in Berlin
sources.evidence: May–September offers long days and warm evenings; June–August are the warmest months, with outdoor cycling, lakes and street life. Summer can reach 30°C; rainfall occurs throughout the year, and evenings can cool. Promotional claims of perfect weather are not treated as guarantees.

sources.title: It's a hot day - check out the cool spots in Bordeaux
sources.publisher: Bordeaux Métropole Tourist Office & Convention Bureau
sources.evidence: Describes summer rooftops, terraces and guinguettes, especially along the Garonne. Warns that summer heat can be difficult and recommends shade, parks, water and indoor cultural refuges. This is general summer guidance, not a July forecast.

sources.title: The Great Migration
sources.evidence: Places the Mara River phase broadly in July–October and explains that the year-round migration follows water and fresh grazing. This is a seasonal window, not an arrival date, crossing timetable or sighting guarantee.

sources.title: HerdTracker - Wildebeest Migration Updates
sources.evidence: Retrieved evergreen FAQs say timing varies each year with rainfall and environmental factors and that the migration has unpredictable elements. Notes use this limitation only; live sightings and predictor outputs are not used as seasonal facts.

sources.title: Great Things to See & Do in Athens in Summer
sources.publisher: This is Athens — The Official Athens Guide
sources.evidence: July–August brings rooftop and courtyard nightlife, coastal outings and outdoor culture. The guide recommends early beach time, air-conditioned galleries or museums and a siesta to avoid the heat. July and August have separate seasonal activity sections; event dates are not adopted as guarantees.

sources.title: What to Pack for Your Trip to Athens
sources.publisher: This is Athens — The Official Athens Guide
sources.evidence: Says summer draws crowds and temperatures can reach 40°C; recommends nearby beaches, sun protection and practical shoes. Crowds thin in early September. This supports flagging July–August as hot, busy choices rather than verified mild-weather sweet spots.
